factor_name: VIX- and Range-Expansion Conditioned Volatility-Normalized Reversal

calculation.description: Fades the three-day cross-sectional overreaction after volatility normalization, strengthening when the instrument's recent trading range expands and when observation-only VIX is high relative to its trailing 252-day history. All inputs are lagged to the completed prior day for live use.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.051644, 607 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.015701, 410 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.035569, 491 dates). Five- and ten-day predictive power decayed but remained positive. Small 15-asset universe requires conservative interpretation.
